# Worked out on an Ayn Odin 2. A fresh save shows the title at about 40 s (A at 45 s; earlier presses were missed on some launches), then the main menu, with a Steam cross-save
# question on a fresh save (B, No). The main menu's cursor starts on Story; Continue is the next row once there is a save. Character creation's first tutorial box takes a held A.
# saves/hold (beside the NSP folder) is the Quick Save tohold ends with: --keep-save <game folder>/saves/hold

column7: The logos and the title screen idling: no input, a fresh save
A fresh save: New Game (Classic), character creation, the opening cinematic, Magister Siwan's first lines, then Quick Save in the Merryweather's hold, for --keep-save
The Merryweather's hold from its Quick Save (saves/hold, made by tohold): Continue, the movement tutorial closed (A held), a short walk, then idling
The hold from its Quick Save for 25 minutes, walking up and down every 20 s: for slowdowns that build up over time

The hold from its Quick Save: Continue, the tutorial closed, the left stick down for 1 s at 84 s and right for 1 s at 95 s, then idling (where each walk ends, in the shots at 90 and 105 s, shows whether the game moves by time or by frames)
